title: Comparing Trial Balance and Aging Reports Between Dynamics GP and Dynamics Business Central (2024)

chapters.title: Trial balance and aging reports in Dynamics GP
Detailed trial balance report in Business Central
Summary trial balance report and export options

features.name: Detailed trial balance report
features.description: Shows balance information and detailed transactions posted to each account, with option to print new page per GL account and filter by specific account or range.

features.name: Summary trial balance report
features.description: Compares current year balances to prior year or budgeted amounts, displays variance as percentage, supports rounding options, and allows filtering by account range and date range.
caveats: requires budgets to be configured for budget comparison

features.name: Report export to Excel
features.description: Allows exporting trial balance reports to Excel format to perform additional analysis and create different visuals for the data.

features.name: Aging report for accounts receivable
features.description: Shows aging information for customers with options to age by transaction date or due date, select aging date, print in detail format, and filter by customer or customer class using posting groups.
caveats: requires customer class information to be migrated as posting groups for filtering
